purpose: functional verification of firmware-booted machines on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: a machine created from the image boots by firmware to the image's login prompt
the console takes input: a login, commands, and a file written
the file survives stop and start
the file survives the guest rebooting itself
what cannot work is refused at creation

detail.network: a machine booted from an image has no network device yet
detail.path: image "../cirros.raw": a file name of letters, digits, -, _ and .
detail.both: give image or templateID, not both
